content.text:
Act as the test sub-agent for this task.

Repo: Moneo (Next.js 16 + React 19 + Supabase personal-finance app). Read AGENTS.md first and follow it. Copy the git-ignored `C:\codebases\Moneo\.env` into your checkout; never print secrets. Use ports 3100 and above, because others may be running dev servers on 3000/3001. `scripts/e2e-auth.mjs` and Playwright honor `E2E_BASE_URL`; check `playwright.config.ts` and set `baseURL`/port via env if needed, without breaking the default.

## Goal
This branch (`t3/voice-finance-agent`) adds a voice feature on top of `main`:
- Overview "Waiting for you" cards
- chat and artifact runs that keep going in the background
- the mic with live transcription
- a GPT-Live voice call in chat
- the call summary card, voice settings and the voice call model

Before the user merges it, make sure **the app is still fast and smooth** and **nothing regressed**. Measure, find regressions against `main`, and fix them.

## Do
1. **Production builds of both:** `npm run build && npx next start -p 3101` for this branch, and the same for `origin/main` in a temporary `git worktree` of origin/main on port 3102. Don't touch `C:\codebases\Moneo`. Sign the QA user in with `node --env-file=.env scripts/e2e-auth.mjs` (with `E2E_BASE_URL`).
2. **Measure each page** on both builds with a Playwright script: TTFB, FCP, LCP, total transfer, JS bytes, and time until the main content is visible. Run 3 times, take the median, desktop and mobile viewport. Pages:
   - Overview `/` (watch the "Waiting for you" section: it runs recurring detection before rendering; check whether it delays the page or streams under Suspense)
   - `/ai` chat
   - the Ask Moneo panel
   - `/ai/artifacts`
   - `/money` pages
   - `/plan`
   - `/settings`
   - `/ai/activity`
3. **Measure interactions:**
   - chat time to first token and to the full answer for a simple question, before and after;
   - the cost of the new running-request polling (every 3 s) and of `loadConversation`'s extra query;
   - mic tap to recording;
   - call button to "live" and first spoken words (`scripts/voice-call-check.mjs` logs timings; extend if needed).

   Check that background polling stops when nothing is running and when the tab is hidden.
4. **Look for smoothness problems:** long tasks over 50 ms, layout shift (CLS) from new sections (Waiting for you, mic UI, call card), unnecessary re-renders while transcripts stream (React profiler or performance marks), and the bundle size of chat routes, since voice code should be lazy-loaded and not add weight to pages that don't use it.
5. **Fix what you find**, simplest first: lazy-load voice and call code, stream slow sections, add missing indexes for new queries (new migration files only; apply with `npx supabase db push --db-url "$SUPABASE_DB_URL"`; the latest version is `202610300006`), debounce or limit polling.
6. **Regression run:**
   - `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`;
   - then the full gated Playwright suite: `node --env-file=.env scripts/e2e-auth.mjs --reset` first, as AGENTS.md says; this only empties the QA workspace and never deletes the user;
   - `node --env-file=.env scripts/voice-call-check.mjs` against your build.

   Fix real failures. A previous report said the panel variants of `chat-cancel` and `chat-drafts` fail because "Ask Moneo" matches two header buttons; fix that test selector if it's still failing.

## Deliver
Branch off your checkout's current commit (`t3/voice-finance-agent`). Commit in small steps; end each commit message with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Before the PR, run `git fetch origin && git merge origin/t3/voice-finance-agent`. Another agent is doing a UI polish pass in parallel, so resolve conflicts keeping both. Push and open a PR with `gh pr create --base t3/voice-finance-agent`. **Do not target main.**

The PR body must have:
- a **before/after table** (main vs. this branch before your fixes vs. after) for each page and interaction;
- the regressions found and how they were fixed;
- the test and E2E results;
- anything skipped;
- "Decisions I made".

End it with `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)`. Do not merge. Ignore the "Entire Gates" approval check. Stop the servers and remove the temporary main worktree when done.

Your final line must be: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.
